name: Diamond
summary: A cut diamond worth 100 gp: what Revivify, Raise Dead and Chromatic Orb ask for. Diamonds count together toward a spell's cost.
text: A clear cut stone worth 100 gp. Spells that call for a diamond of some worth take as many as add up to it (three for Revivify's 300 gp), and some use them up.
